# multiRL
```{r}
multiRL.input <- process_1_input(
  data = read.csv("../DATA/DATA.csv") |> dplyr::filter(Subject == 1),
  colnames = list(
    subid = "Subject", 
    block = "Block",
    trial = "Trial",
    
    object = c("Object_1", "Object_2", "Object_3", "Object_4"), 
    reward = c("Reward_1", "Reward_2", "Reward_3", "Reward_4"),
    action = "Action"
  )
)
```

```{r}
multiRL.behrules <- process_2_rule(
  rule = list(
    cue = c("Red", "Yellow", "Green", "Blue"),
    rsp = c("Up", "Down", "Left", "Right")
  )
)
```

```{r}
multiRL.record <- process_3_record(
  input = multiRL.input,
  behrules = multiRL.behrules
)
```

```{r}
multiRL.output <- process_4_loop(
  record = multiRL.record,
  rate_func = func_alpha,
  util_func = func_gamma,
  prob_func = func_beta
)
```

## binaryRL

```{r}
multiRL.input <- process_1_input(
  data = binaryRL::Mason_2024_G2 |> dplyr::filter(Subject == 1),
  colnames = list(
    subid = "Subject", 
    block = "Block",
    trial = "Trial",
    
    object = c("L_choice", "R_choice"), 
    reward = c("L_reward", "R_reward"),
    action = "Sub_Choose"
  )
)
```

```{r}
multiRL.behrules <- process_2_rule(
  rule = list(
    cue = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
    rsp = c("A", "B", "C", "D")
  )
)
```

```{r}
multiRL.record <- process_3_record(
  input = multiRL.input,
  behrules = multiRL.behrules
)
```

```{r}
multiRL.output <- process_4_loop(
  record = multiRL.record,
  rate_func = func_alpha,
  util_func = func_gamma,
  prob_func = func_beta
)
```
